Abstract
Diffusion models have demonstrated impressive generation
capabilities, particularly with recent advancements leveraging transformer architectures to improve both visual and

artistic quality. However, Diffusion Transformers (DiTs)
continue to encounter challenges related to low inference
speed, primarily due to the iterative denoising process. To
address this issue, we propose BlockDance, a training-free
approach that explores feature similarities at adjacent time
steps to accelerate DiTs. Unlike previous feature-reuse meth-
